duties.gap: The decision construction (type elimination together with the witness criterion and the unravelling) is complete. The GF finite-model construction is written out (annex 790-861), but its central step, Herwig's extension theorem, is imported as an unproved premise (body 636-648). The complete original finite-model construction for the guarded fragment is therefore not supplied: Herwig's extension theorem has to be proved, or the finite-model property has to be derived by another complete construction.
